class.name: GameplayEffectSpec
class.brief_description: One application of a GameplayEffect: how strong, from whom, and with which values.
class.description: The effect stays a shared, authored [Resource]; a spec is made per use and is cheap. "Fireball does 40 at level 3" is one asset and a spec at level 3, not ten assets. Make one with [method AbilitySystemComponent.make_outgoing_spec] or [method GameplayAbility.make_outgoing_spec], set what only the moment knows, and apply it. [codeblock] var spec := asc.make_outgoing_spec(DAMAGE, 3.0) spec.set_set_by_caller_magnitude(&"Damage", -roll_damage()) spec.context = { "position": hit_position } asc.apply_gameplay_effect_spec_to_target(spec, target_asc) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_set_by_caller_magnitude
method.description: The value set under [param name], or [param default_value].

method.name: get_source
method.description: The component that made the spec, or null - also once it has been freed. Attribute-based modifiers with [constant AttributeModifier.SOURCE] read it.

method.name: has_set_by_caller_magnitude
method.description: Whether a value was set under [param name].

method.name: set_set_by_caller_magnitude
method.description: Sets the value a [constant AttributeModifier.SET_BY_CALLER] modifier named [param name] reads.

method.name: set_source
method.description: Sets the source. Held by id, so a freed source reads as null rather than dangling.

members.member: Free-form data about this application - where it hit, with what. Nothing in the framework reads it; it is passed to gameplay cues as the [code]context[/code] parameter.
The level [member AttributeModifier.level_curve] is sampled at.
